purpose: Test the duration-augmented Token-Energy functional form in a distinct two-GH200 tensor-parallel stratum, with both physical-device energies measured over one common decode boundary.

stratum.accelerator_pair: two NVIDIA GH200 144GB HBM3e devices in one node
stratum.parallel_runtime: vLLM V0 tensor parallel with NCCL
stratum.clock_policy: reset application clocks before qualification; do not lock or sweep clocks
stratum.co_run_policy: both physical GPUs must have at most 16 MiB allocated immediately before every attempt

qualification_design.purpose: Feasibility and meter-boundary admission only; qualification energies never enter a fit, gate, or paper outcome.

identification_design.qualification_gate: all three qualification runs must have exactly one accepted alignment under the frozen qualification lock

measurement_policy.primary_energy_scope: sum of scope-0 instantaneous-power integrals from both visible GH200 devices over identical go/done monotonic boundaries
measurement_policy.secondary_energy_scope: sum of two scope-1 module instantaneous-power integrals and two independent cumulative-energy counters

analysis_policy.equation: E_pair_token = intercept_tp2 + alpha_tp2 * weight_decimal_GB_per_token + beta_tp2 * kv_read_write_decimal_GB_per_token + p_time_tp2_W * decode_seconds_per_useful_token
analysis_policy.estimator: unweighted ordinary least squares with HC3 covariance
analysis_policy.traffic_slope_gate: Bonferroni familywise one-sided 0.05 lower bounds for alpha_tp2 and beta_tp2 must both exceed zero
analysis_policy.time_term_gate: p_time_tp2_W must be finite and nonnegative and is not literal idle power
analysis_policy.communication_policy: TP=2 is a separate execution stratum. NVLink/NCCL traffic may change fitted coefficients or residuals, but no communication coefficient is identifiable from this fixed-TP model and none may be added after outcomes are seen.

holdout_gates.unit_of_analysis: cell mean over five independent runs

claim_policy.passing_unopened_holdout_supports: the same duration-augmented functional form with TP2-specific coefficients in the pinned two-GH200 NV18 stratum over the tested interpolation domain
not_authorized: separate causal attribution of NVLink or NCCL energy
advance latency prediction without a separate duration predictor
causal interpretation of the time coefficient as literal idle power
